id: title:fercgomes:serialize cloud run admission per user

review.posthog_relevance: Adds PostgreSQL advisory transaction locking to the Cloud Run admission control workflow, preventing concurrent requests for the same project and user from bypassing admission checks.
review.reason: The implementation in P1.F2.H2 introduces a PostgreSQL advisory transaction lock (`pg_advisory_xact_lock`) before the admission policy check. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement: it prevents race conditions where concurrent requests could bypass admission limits, protecting the active-run check and limit rolling. review.uncertainty: The score relies on the implementation being correctly wired and tested; P1.F4 is a test but its assertions are not shown, and P1.F2.H1 is a dependency. No runtime behavior or test results are provided, so the benefit is inferred from the implementation rather than demonstrated. No adoption or incident avoidance is established.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a documentation and implementation change. P1.F1.H1 is documentation only. P1.F2 and P1.F3 show the implementation of a PostgreSQL advisory transaction lock. P1.F4 is a test. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: P1.F1.H1 adds a section '## Concurrent creation' and a paragraph explaining that Cloud run creation holds a PostgreSQL transaction advisory lock, while Local runs do not. No code change.
observations.code_quote: Cloud run creation holds a PostgreSQL transaction advisory lock for the project and user.
observations.posthog_connection: Documentation of the admission control behavior.

observations.behavior: Import addition: P1.F2.H1 adds the Django database connection import to admission.py.
observations.posthog_connection: Prerequisite for executing raw SQL advisory locks.

observations.behavior: Implementation: P1.F2.H2 adds a new function `lock_cloud_run_creation` that acquires a PostgreSQL advisory transaction lock using `pg_advisory_xact_lock`. The lock key is constructed from a namespace and team/user IDs. This is called before the existing admission policy check.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a transactional advisory lock to prevent concurrent requests for the same project and user from bypassing admission checks. This protects the active-run check and limit rolling.
